subject: Suspected telemetry spike — request for IR plan & artifact snapshot
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice@clearpoint.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearpoint.com
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Suspected telemetry spike — request for IR plan & artifact snapshot

Hi Priya,

We observed an unusual spike in token-generation telemetry for our Clearpoint sandbox tenant around 2027-03-07T11:30Z. The spike coincides with a set of API keys that our automated tooling flagged as higher-than-normal downstream throughput. We have not published keys to any third parties.

Given the sensitivity of the data that flows through those endpoints, we need Redwood to:
- Confirm whether this activity originated from Redwood-managed infra or an external actor
- Share your incident response plan section that applies to tenant telemetry spikes and exfil candidates (SOC 2 relevant)
- Provide a compressed evidence snapshot (logs + request traces + token-level sampling) for 11:00–12:00Z on 2027-03-07 in a redacted form we can ingest

We prefer a secure upload link (S3 presigned or Drive with restricted access). If this is an internal benign explanation, please let us know quickly — our legal/regulatory team has opened a holding notice.

Thanks,
Alice Turner
Senior Cloud Security Engineer
Clearpoint Financial
Attachments: clearpoint_telemetry_excerpt.csv (csv, 12 KB)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice@clearpoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 13:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suspected telemetry spike — request for IR plan & artifact snapshot

Alice — thanks for the heads up and for the CSV excerpt. We take this seriously. High level next steps from our side:

1) We will triage immediately and run a targeted evidence snapshot for the interval you specified (11:00–12:00Z). That snapshot will include request traces, ingress IPs, API key usage, and internal routing metadata. We will redact PII and any unrelated tenant data.

2) We're attaching a short guide for how we produce the compressed snapshot and what redaction looks like. If you have a preferred upload location, share it; otherwise we'll provision a presigned S3 link with 7-day expiry.

3) Marissa (security lead) and Karthik (IR runbook owner) are looped for containment and telemetry parsing.

Requested info from your side to speed the handoff:
- Confirm which tenant ID(s) to prioritize
- Any immediate IP allow/block lists you want applied before snapshot collection (we can throttle on our side)
- Contact for a scheduled 30-min tabletop if this escalates (we can host today)

I will start the snapshot job now and update you with an ETA for the upload.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Security Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_ir_snapshot_instructions.md (md, 3 KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suspected telemetry spike — request for IR plan & artifact snapshot

Adding operational tasks and owners:
- Karthik: kick off the compressed evidence extraction (use snapshot template v2) and mark telemetry windows 2027-03-07T11:00Z–12:00Z. Include KV cache access logs and batch routing metadata.
- Priya: provision secure upload and inform Alice once available.
- Marissa: review redaction and prepare a one-page incident summary for the customer and internal SOC.

If we see signs of credential compromise we'll initiate our containment play (rotate keys + temporary tenant quiesce). Keep all comms to the thread — legal will request timeline and chain later.

Marissa Cole
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice@clearpoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, security@clearpoint.com
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Final: postmortem & redacted artifacts for 2027-03-07 telemetry spike

Alice — follow up with the outcome and artifacts:

Summary: Our investigation determined that the telemetry spike was caused by an internal customer integration that replayed a backfilled test dataset during your sandbox ingestion window. No unauthorized third-party access was detected. Key points:
- The activity originated from a Clearpoint-scheduled job (confirmed by API key fingerprint and request patterns).
- No anomalous IP addresses or credential leak indicators were found.
- We validated request traces and KV cache interaction; nothing consistent with exfiltration was observed.

Artifacts provided (redacted):
- redwood_postmortem_redacted.pdf — one-page summary + timeline + actions (PDF, 48 KB)
- snapshot_20270307_1100-1200.tar.gz — compressed traces (redacted) uploaded to the secure Drive link below
- redaction_manifest.txt — list of fields removed from request bodies

Secure access: https://drive.redwood-inference.com/s/clearpoint/ir-redacted-artifacts (granted to alice@clearpoint.com, expires 2027-03-15)

Actions taken:
- Confirmed ownership of the job with Clearpoint's engineering contact (per your CSV)
- Recommended that you add a short pre-flight validation to the ingestion job to avoid large backfills during peak windows; shared a sample webhook guard in the Drive folder
- We did not rotate keys because no compromise signal was present; if you want a precautionary rotation, we can execute on your schedule

If you prefer a 30-min wrap-up call to walk through the artifacts and the redaction manifest, I'm available today between 14:00–16:00 PT.

Thanks for raising this quickly — glad we could confirm no incident.

—Priya Natarajan
Account Security Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_postmortem_redacted.pdf (pdf, 48 KB), snapshot_20270307_1100-1200.tar.gz (tgz, 3.2 MB)
